name: Past Futaba
source:
Futaba's previous incarnation.
[spoiler]She was sent away from her family due to being a twin, and thus believed to be a bad omen.[/spoiler]
She made contracts with the four previous incarnations of the Dawn faction ayakashi, as well as Yura, whose current incarnation was alive back then.
[spoiler]When she returned home, her whole family had been killed due to an enemy onmyouji's curse. She died in the arms of Kouga's past incarnation during an attempt to purify wraiths in the city, something Kouga still feels guilty about one lifetime later.[/spoiler]
